_comment: SG40 / R8.3 / R8.4. The stronghold's own words: the reveal, the Warden, and the freeing. Same `{"conversations": {...}}` shape as opening.json, merged onto the same table by scripts/story/dialogue_runner.gd's EXTRA_DIALOGUE_PATHS. CUT HARD on 2026-09-04 (owner: 'the dialogue at the end needs to be cut way down. it was paragraphs with the warden. then paragraphs on the legendary thing'). Budget, asserted by tests/test_stronghold_dialogue_budget.gd on the merged table: no line over 110 characters, the Warden's challenge under 350, the whole file under 2,000. The freeing carries its weight visually (the creature steps out of the machine, stronghold_climax.gd) rather than in text.
_comment_exemption: THIS IS THE ONE FILE ALLOWED TO NAME THE LEGENDARY. tests/test_dialogue_runner.gd's spoiler scan forbids 'legendary', 'veridian', 'stag', 'living power' and 'power source' in every other file the player can read; this path is that test's single STRONGHOLD_FILES exemption, because spec sec32 puts the reveal inside the stronghold.
_comment_order: Spec sec28's order is not optional: the READOUT (`stronghold_reveal`) sits on the arena threshold so the player learns what is at the far end of the cables BEFORE the Warden speaks and before the fight; then his dialogue; then the battle; only then the chamber conversations.
_comment_portraits: 2026-09-04 portrait contract: the Warden speaks with warden.png (the file is produced by another lane; the panel leaves the frame empty until it lands). The readout, the duty board and the chamber narration are what the PLAYER reads and sees, so they carry the player's own portrait -- the only one the contract gives a first-person beat.
_comment_warden: Spec sec33, and it survives the cut whole: he believes separation prevents chaos, he confirms the readout rather than denying it, he says a version of 'you don't understand what these barriers are holding apart', and he does not recant when he loses. He never says 'you cannot stop me'.

stronghold_duty_board._comment: R-2 (GATE3_ENCOUNTER_CONTRACTS.md sec7.2): the garrison's numbers at band 5's waystop. Team sizes match data/config/bands/band5_stronghold_approach/trainers.json (Verrick 2, Solene 3, Hald 3, Warden Aldis 5). Names ONLY the draw; never what chamber five holds.
stronghold_duty_board.speaker: Tether Duty Board
lines: GARRISON DUTY BOARD — HALL APPROACH.
VERRICK — 2. SOLENE — 3. HALD — 3. WARDEN — 5.
Each post stands until relieved. None stand down early.
NO RELIEF UNTIL THE DRAW IS STABLE.

stronghold_reveal._comment: SG40. A Team Tether maintenance readout at the arena threshold, in the flat voice of a status board. It says sec32's three things: the legendary is the source, Team Tether is drawing on it, and they know exactly what they are doing.
stronghold_reveal.speaker: Tether Readout
lines: MEADOWS STATION — PRIMARY DRAW. STATUS: NOMINAL. SEVEN SPOKES HELD.
SOURCE: LEGENDARY CLASS. DESIGNATION VERIDIAN. CONTAINED, CHAMBER 5.
DRAW SUSTAINED 1,411 DAYS. SUBJECT VITALS: DECLINING, WITHIN TOLERANCE.

lines.text: Every cable in the Meadows ends here. Something alive is holding the Rifts apart.

stronghold_warden_challenge._comment: R8.3, spec Act VI step 34. He confirms the board, argues it is worth it, and challenges. His last line is the challenge; trainer_npc.gd starts the fight when the words run out, so nothing here carries a `battle:` effect.
stronghold_warden_challenge.speaker: Warden Aldis
lines: You read the board. Good. Then you know it is true. There is no lie to find.
Those seams hold back a country that is not gentle. I have read the years it came through.
Freedom without control becomes disorder. Someone has to carry that. I know what it costs.
You don't understand what these barriers are holding apart. So show me. Beat mine.

stronghold_warden_defeated._comment: R8.3. He loses and does not fold: concedes the fight, concedes nothing else, and warns.
stronghold_warden_defeated.speaker: Warden Aldis
lines: Well fought. I won't stop you at the door. That was the wager.
But I was not wrong. Pull it out of that machine and the seams come down. Your village first.
Take the warning. Chamber five. Do it knowing.

stronghold_chamber._comment: R8.4. The first thing the player is given in the chamber is a LOOK. The creature is INSIDE the machine (OP-0904-8), in the cage at its heart.
stronghold_chamber.speaker: Chamber Five
lines: Chamber five is one room and one machine, and the machine is running.
Inside it, in the cage at its heart, a stag stands with its head down.
It lifts its head and looks at you. Every cable in this building ends at its feet.

stronghold_free_legendary._comment: R8.4, spec sec28 steps 1-2. The choice is made HERE with the Warden's warning unrefuted. `flag:legendary_freed` rides the line the cage drops on, exactly once.
stronghold_free_legendary.speaker: Chamber Five
lines: A lever with a painted grip. Built by people who never imagined anyone would pull it.

lines.text: You pull it. The cage drops its light. After 1,411 days, nothing is holding it there.

lines: It steps out of the machine, slowly, and the light that comes up off it is its own.

stronghold_legendary_joins._comment: R8.4, spec sec28 step 3: it VOLUNTARILY offers. No orb, no fight. A full belt hands the decision to R4.10's release ceremony via Game.pending_catch.
stronghold_legendary_joins.speaker: Chamber Five
lines: It crosses to you and puts its head down until the two of you are level.
Nothing is asked with an orb. It is offering. Walk out, and it would follow.

stronghold_machinery_fails._comment: R8.4, spec sec28 step 5. Fails AFTER the join and the five-creature decision. The exterior world event is SG44's and reads `legendary_freed`; this is only the last thing said indoors.
stronghold_machinery_fails.speaker: Chamber Five
lines: Behind you, the machine notices what it has lost. It does not explode. It runs down.
The core light goes from teal to nothing. The sound this building has made stops.
In the quiet, a long way off and getting louder, something very large begins to move.
Aldis said the seams come down. He was right about that much.
